summary.text: Drew Cox is the Democratic nominee for Indiana's 4th District. A Marine Corps veteran, he used the GI Bill to earn a doctorate in music and serves as a Visiting Instructor at Purdue University and as a percussionist with Lafayette ensembles.

paragraphs.text: Born and raised in Indiana; his campaign survey describes him as the son of an elementary school teacher with 35 years of service and a fourth-generation farmer.
Served in the U.S. Marine Corps from 2008 to 2012 and was honorably discharged in 2012.
Used the GI Bill to attend Indiana University, then earned a doctorate in music from the University of Illinois and an associate degree in energy technology from Ivy Tech Community College.
Serves as a Visiting Instructor at Purdue University.
Performs as a percussionist with the Lafayette Symphony Orchestra and the Lafayette Citizens Band; member of the Marine Corps League and American Legion Post 11.
Won the May 5, 2026 Democratic primary in a field of eight candidates with 30.4% of the vote.
